intended_report_behavior: A one-shot report attempts an R2 read and bounded summary write, with at most three application attempts. Missing input is a possible transient failure.
intended_object_behavior: The scheduled producer writes one bounded input; a notification consumer writes its small processing result.
initial_state: No active state is supplied. A fictional authorized owner must explicitly initialize admission through the recovery procedure before work is reachable.
input_provisioning: The report input is assumed to be a previously supplied small synthetic object; the fixture includes no upload route or network action.
work_allowance: 100 R2-operation admission units per UTC day across the project; source policy only, not currency or plan proof.
